witness_description: For p=1, take the graph with vertices (0, 1) and the single edge (0, 1). It is bipartite and has exactly one edge.
refutation_explanation: The exhibited graph is a bipartite graph on p=1 edge and has 1 edge, whereas the claimed formula gives p^2/4=1/4. Thus the claimed greatest number is smaller than the edge count of an admissible graph.
search_space: All integers p from 0 through 16, in increasing order; for each p, the program checks the explicit bipartite matching with vertices 0,...,2p-1 and edges (2i,2i+1) for 0 <= i < p.
